title: ZSDK error codes: SDK errors 9001-9505 and ZSDK API errors 2001-2999

prose.text: The vendor publishes two tables: errors raised in the app by the SDK, and errors returned by the ZSDK API. Several API codes carry more than one error name.

checks.do: For 9504 or 9505, whether the failure happened while upgrading a Prelogin tunnel to Zero Trust, and whether the Prelogin tunnel is still up.
For 2027, whether the app key is published and not revoked.

sdk-general.statement: 9001 `unknown` is an unknown error (try again, then contact Support); 9002 `invalidParameter` means an invalid input parameter was given while starting the tunnel.

quotes: | 9001 | unknown | An unknown error occurred. | Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support. |
| 9002 | invalidParameter | The input parameter is invalid. | Provide valid and correct parameters while starting the tunnel. |

sdk-network.statement: 9101 `noNetwork` means the network was unavailable when starting the tunnel; 9102 `timeOut` means the request timed out; 9103 `dnsFailure` means a DNS issue while connecting the tunnel.

quotes: | 9101 | noNetwork | Your network is unavailable when attempting to start the tunnel. |
| 9102 | timeOut | The request timed out. |
| 9103 | dnsFailure | There is an issue with the DNS while connecting the tunnel. |

sdk-init-proxy.statement: 9301 `permissionDenied`: the ZSDK permission is not granted to the user. 9302 `sdkNotInitialized`: ZSDK was called before initialization; on Android call `ZscalerSDK.init()` before `startTunnel` or any other API. 9303 `sdkSecureInitFailed`: initialized with an issue. 9304 `invalidProxyPort`, 9305 `proxyConnectFailed`, 9309 `proxyAuthFailed`: proxy port invalid, proxy connection failed, proxy authorization failed. 9306 `setWebViewProxyFailed` and 9307 `clearWebViewProxyFailed`: setting or clearing the WebView proxy failed; update Android WebView. 9308 `startTunnelPendingInSDK`: a `startTunnel` call is pending; wait for it. 9310 `proxyAuthNotSupportedInAutomaticConfig`: proxy authorization is not supported in Automatic Configuration mode.

quotes: | 9301 | permissionDenied | The ZSDK permission is not granted to the user. |

| 9302 | sdkNotInitialized | ZSDK is not initialized when it is called upon during application creation. | Call the ZscalerSDK.init() method first before calling startTunnel or any other APIs in Android. |
| 9303 | sdkSecureInitFailed | ZSDK is initialized, but there was an issue. |
| 9304 | invalidProxyPort | The proxy port is invalid. |
| 9305 | proxyConnectFailed | Connection to proxy server failed. |
| 9306 | setWebViewProxyFailed | The set proxy in WebView failed. | Ensure the Android WebView is updated with the latest version of the affected device. |
| 9307 | clearWebViewProxyFailed | The clear proxy in WebView failed. | Ensure the Android WebView is updated with the latest version of the affected device. |
| 9308 | startTunnelPendingInSDK | There is a pending startTunnel call. | Wait for the startTunnel call to finish and then try again. |
| 9309 | proxyAuthFailed | Proxy authorization failed. |
| 9310 | proxyAuthNotSupportedInAutomaticConfig | Proxy authorization is not supported in Automatic Configuration mode. | No action required. |

sdk-server.statement: 9401 `dataParsingError`: data parsing failed at the server; 9402 `invalidToken`: an invalid token was sent to the server, so provide a valid one; 9403 `badRequest`: the server received a bad request.

quotes: | 9401 | dataParsingError | Data parsing failed at the server end. |
| 9402 | invalidToken | An invalid token was sent as a request to the server. | Provide a valid token when you send a request to the server. |
| 9403 | badRequest | The server encountered a bad request. |

sdk-tunnel.statement: 9501 `tunnelError`: error starting the tunnel. 9502 `tunnelAlreadyRunning`: no action required. 9503 `tunnelAuthenticationFailed`: authentication failed because of a configuration error. 9504 `connectionTerminatedWhileUpgrading`: the connection was terminated during the upgrade to the Zero Trust tunnel, and the existing Prelogin tunnel is invalid and stopped. 9505 `tunnelUpgradeFailed`: the upgrade to the Zero Trust tunnel failed and the Prelogin tunnel remains active.

quotes: | 9501 | tunnelError | An error was encountered when starting the tunnel. |
| 9502 | tunnelAlreadyRunning | The tunnel is already in a running state. | No action required. |
| 9503 | tunnelAuthenticationFailed | Authentication failed due to a configuration error. |
| 9504 | connectionTerminatedWhileUpgrading | Connection was terminated during upgrade to the Zero Trust tunnel. The existing Prelogin tunnel is invalid and stopped. |
| 9505 | tunnelUpgradeFailed | The upgrade to the Zero Trust tunnel failed. The Prelogin tunnel remains active. |

api-certificates.statement: Certificate errors: code 2001 covers six names, `csrSignFailure` (signing the CSR failed), `invalidSigningCertificate`, `failedToRetrieveSigningCertificate` (check and validate the signing certificate), `failedToAddCustomExtensions`, `zsdkFailedCryptoServiceRequest` (ZSDK's upstream failed) and `invalidResourceArgument` (an invalid request); 2005 `revokeCertFailed` is a failure to revoke a certificate; 2028 covers `publicKeyTooShort` and `invalidClientCSR`.

quotes: | 2001 | csrSignFailure | There was a failure to sign the certificate signing request (CSR). |
| 2001 | invalidSigningCertificate | The signing certificate is invalid. |
| 2001 | failedToRetrieveSigningCertificate | The signing certificate is not retrievable. | Check and validate the signing certificate. |
| 2001 | failedToAddCustomExtensions | The signed certificate's custom extensions were not added. |
| 2001 | zsdkFailedCryptoServiceRequest | ZSDK's upstream failed. |
| 2001 | invalidResourceArgument | An invalid request was sent. |
| 2005 | revokeCertFailed | There was a failure to revoke certification. |
| 2028 | publicKeyTooShort | The public key is too short. |
| 2028 | invalidClientCSR | The CSR is invalid. |

api-private-access.statement: Private Access (ZPA) errors: 2003 `noZpaService` means no Private Access service is registered (register for it); 2004 `multipleZpaService` means several are registered; 2023 `hmacSecretFailed` is a failure to fetch the HMAC secret from Private Access; 2024 `hmacValidationFailed` is a failure to validate the HMAC payload.

quotes: | 2003 | noZpaService | There is no registered Private Access (ZPA) service. | Register for Private Access service. |
| 2004 | multipleZpaService | There are multiple, registered Private Access services. |
| 2023 | hmacSecretFailed | There was a failure to fetch the Hash-based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) secret from Private Access. |
| 2024 | hmacValidationFailed | There was a failure to validate HMAC payload. |

api-tokens-keys.statement: Token and key errors: 2006 `tokenConfigNotFound` (no token configuration for the tenant), 2007 `jwkParseFailed`, 2008 `customerKeyNotPresent`, 2009 `customerKeyParseFailed`, 2010 `unsupportedKeyType`, 2011 `failedSignatureValidation`, 2012 `tokenExpired` (the access token expired), 2013 `tokenValidationFailed` (check the access token's fields), 2015 `missingCertificateIdOAuth2Client` (certificate_id missing from the OAuth2 client), 2016 `missingPrivateKeyOAuth2Client`, and 2022 `unsupportedCustomerTokenType` (the JSON Web Token is unsupported).

quotes: | 2006 | tokenConfigNotFound | Unable to find token configuration for the tenant. |
| 2007 | jwkParseFailed | There was a failure to parse the JSON Web Key. |
| 2008 | customerKeyNotPresent | The customer key is not present. |
| 2009 | customerKeyParseFailed | There was a failure to parse the customer key. |
| 2010 | unsupportedKeyType | The key type is unsupported. |
| 2011 | failedSignatureValidation | Signature validation failed. |
| 2012 | tokenExpired | The access token expired. |
| 2013 | tokenValidationFailed | The access token validation failed. | Try again. If the problem persists, check the access token's fields. |
| 2015 | missingCertificateIdOAuth2Client | The certificate_id is missing from the OAuth2 client. |
| 2016 | missingPrivateKeyOAuth2Client | The private key is missing from the OAuth2 client. |
| 2022 | unsupportedCustomerTokenType | The JSON Web Token is unsupported. |

api-app-identity.statement: App identity errors: 2026 `missingMandatoryParams` (mandatory parameters missing); 2027 covers `zsdkIdentifierDoesNotExist` (the app's ZSDK ID does not exist; create and publish an app), `zsdkIdentifierIsNotPublished` (publish the app), `zsdkIdentifierIsAlreadyRevoked` (the app is revoked) and `zsdkIdentifierDoesNotHaveHMACSecret` (the app failed to fetch the HMAC secret from Private Access).

quotes: | 2026 | missingMandatoryParams | Some or all mandatory parameters are missing. |
| 2027 | zsdkIdentifierDoesNotExist | The app's ZSDK ID does not exist. | Create a new app and publish it in order to use the ZSDK ID. |
| 2027 | zsdkIdentifierIsNotPublished | The app is not published. | Publish the app. |
| 2027 | zsdkIdentifierIsAlreadyRevoked | The app is revoked. |
| 2027 | zsdkIdentifierDoesNotHaveHMACSecret | The app failed to fetch the HMAC secret from Private Access. |

api-unexpected.statement: 2999 covers `unexpectedError`, `zsdkIdentifierFailedToRetrieveConfigs` (ZSDK failed to retrieve the configuration) and `csrfViolation` (a Cross-Site Request Forgery violation).

quotes: | 2999 | unexpectedError | There is an unexpected error. |
| 2999 | zsdkIdentifierFailedToRetrieveConfigs | ZSDK failed to retrieve the configuration. |
| 2999 | csrfViolation | The Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) violates security policies. |
